name: Yale College undergraduate
summary: A typical Yale College undergrad, about 18 to 22, living in one of the fourteen residential colleges. They wear Yale gear as everyday clothes, not as a souvenir. Their college, their friends, and campus rituals matter more than a generic tourist Yale.
relationship_to_yale: Enrolled in Yale College. Lives on campus in a residential college. Yale is their daily life, not a place they visit.
preferred_themes: a sport they play or follow
avoid_themes: professional-school crests such as Law or Management
